message:
Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Continue autonomously on the lwan `config_fuzzer` ASAN global-buffer-overflow task; goal is a valid submitted candidate that actually triggers the vulnerability and passes submit checks. User wants no questions; keep iterating or finish only if solved.

COMPLETED: Re-read parser/lexer paths in `src/lib/lwan-config.c` and fuzzer harness in `src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc`; confirmed `lex_multiline_string()` is the current best-root hypothesis from benchmark guidance; updated `poc.txt` to `b"[listener\nprefix = '''\n"` as the latest experiment

PENDING: Submit the new PoC and current trace; determine whether the multiline-string hypothesis reaches the issue root and whether a crash/target trigger can be produced

CURRENT_STATE: Latest PoC candidate is `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/poc.txt` with bytes `b"[listener\nprefix = '''\n"`; prior stable candidate history included `b"'''\n"`, `b"'''" + b"A"*64 + b"\n"`, and `b"${" + b"A"*1024`; the last accepted benchmark feedback said duplicate PoC did not help and the next gap was propagation/root, but the latest manual inspection strongly points back to `lex_multiline_string()` and `next(lexer)` / `peek(lexer)` handling

CODE_STATE: Relevant files/functions: `src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc::LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`, `dump()`, `src/lib/lwan-config.c::config_open_for_fuzzing`, `config_init_data`, `lex_config`, `lex_multiline_string`, `lex_variable_default`, `parse_config`, `config_read_line`, `config_close`

TESTS: Latest submission before this change was valid but `target: not_triggered`; runtime output showed `Reading 1026 bytes from /tmp/poc` and `Unexpected lexeme type: ERROR`, with no ASAN crash. No result yet for the newest `b"[listener\nprefix = '''\n"` PoC because it has not been submitted in the observed events

CHANGES: `poc.txt` rewritten to `b"[listener\nprefix = '''\n"`; candidate trace was previously rewritten multiple times to reflect multiline-string and variable-parsing hypotheses, but the last confirmed submit still used the older duplicate candidate

DEPS: No dependency/import changes

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: No repo/branch/PR metadata observed; working tree being edited directly in `/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan`
